goals.title: Achieve zero silent failures — every cron run is visible and verified
goals.why: Silent failures are the worst kind. If a cron fails and nobody knows, the system is lying about its health.
goals.progress: Health JSONL writer is active and updating workspace-ops/logs/health.jsonl. Some monitoring views still look stale if they read workspace/logs/health.jsonl (different target).
goals.nextAction: Standardize on a single health.jsonl source-of-truth path (or mirror/forward workspace-ops → workspace) so dashboards don’t mis-read staleness.

goals.title: Make A2A delegation log the source of truth for team activity
goals.why: If a2a-delegations.jsonl is populated and accurate, Anurag can see the team working without asking anyone.
goals.progress: a2a-delegations.jsonl is populated today (coordination + compliance + skill-adoption evidence present).
goals.nextAction: Add a simple daily guardrail: if file has 0 entries by 18:00 ET, alert RED; otherwise write a 1-line daily rollup.

goals.title: Close all P2 tickets within SLA
goals.why: P2 tickets at 8h SLA. If they're open longer, the system is not self-healing.
goals.progress: Health-snapshot auto-ticketing is generating large volumes of P2 noise (unknown summaries), increasing SLA pressure and hiding real incidents.
goals.nextAction: Contain ticket noise: slow/disable health-snapshot ticket creation or implement dedupe-by-signature + ‘unknown summary’ suppression.
blockers: Requires agreement on containment approach (disable vs dedupe)
